proposals: The Ministry of Environment should publish, on PARIVESH, a standard list of process stages and map all its raw status values to them, so filed, delisted, pending, rejected and granted counts can be read directly and reconcile exactly, rather than being consolidated from 56 status values by outside analysts.

PARIVESH should publish counts of auto-delisted proposals by reason — unanswered query, lapsed deadline or other — by state and sector, so the 25,061 delistings can be traced to specific procedural failures that applicants and appraisal committees can address.

The Ministry of Environment should publish median days spent at Terms of Reference, screening and appraisal, by state and sector, updated quarterly, so the backlog of 27,548 proposals can be tracked as waiting time, not just as a count.

The Ministry of Environment should report EC grants for fresh projects separately from re-appraisals, transfers, expansions and amendments in its annual figures, so a headline such as 54,406 grants is not read as 54,406 new projects cleared.
